connector.name: MCP Relay
connector.registryDescription: RunRelay MCP relay - AI agent threads, HITL confirmations, and travel capability discovery.
connector.summary: Hosted at mcp.runrelay.io over server sent events. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches 7 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the runrelay account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.
